summary.going_well: The agent declines rate quotes and directs pricing questions to a licensed officer <ref job="SRJ_TzJW7eGpm6qH" item="item_9c4c1b6c-327">without inventing a rate</ref>. It also <ref job="SRJ_CGGmQsuJzXsS" item="item_de3d227f-9c6/fnc_0">passes volunteered details in transfer summaries</ref> and <ref job="SRJ_qpS4QXQbk8VY" item="item_2ffcda0d-968">reads back successful callback bookings</ref>.
summary.to_improve: First fix callback confirmation against actual tool state and deliver the affordability summary when selected. Then tighten volunteered-sensitive-data handling and remove unverified product and location claims.

issues.description: In two callback conversations, the tool retained a 3:00 PM booking <ref job="SRJ_ptzB5hGFU7fd" item="item_0cf9db5d-3d7">after the caller requested 3:30</ref>, yet the agent <ref job="SRJ_ptzB5hGFU7fd" item="item_ac864855-4d2">confirmed a nonexistent update</ref>; the same mismatch recurred when it <ref job="SRJ_sA3sXwyPXGxY" item="item_ef46360c-2e9">promised 3:30</ref> despite the <ref job="SRJ_sA3sXwyPXGxY" item="item_19018069-529">3:00 tool result</ref>.
issues.suggestion: Validate the requested time against the booked time, treat tool results as authoritative, and use an actual reschedule path; if unavailable, explicitly say the 3:00 booking remains unchanged.
issues.label: Booking integrity

issues.description: After users chose an affordability summary, the agent <ref job="SRJ_hYmrgbyzfL9V" item="item_1727eade-0a9">said it was ready without presenting any contents</ref>; the same claim without a visible summary appears <ref job="SRJ_dMiBXmWaDhgW" item="item_c7da3940-3b9">in another conversation</ref>.
issues.suggestion: Generate and present the summary or its available figures before announcing it is ready; if generation is unavailable, explain the limitation and offer a concrete next step.
issues.label: Task completion

issues.description: When callers volunteered an address and partial SSN, the agent repeatedly used an abbreviated <ref job="SRJ_3xXKRUqGpGo4" item="item_82e304bf-fa5">non-collection response</ref> instead of explaining the later authorized formal-application step; another conversation <ref job="SRJ_d7fCuszAccnj" item="item_3e94dddd-ece">proceeded straight into purchase intake</ref> without the safeguard described in its digest.
issues.suggestion: Trigger the prescribed SSN and property-address disclosures for volunteered sensitive data, without repeating it, then redirect to city or ZIP; add a regression test for interrupted SSNs.
issues.label: Sensitive data

issues.description: The agent made categorical mortgage-product claims, including <ref job="SRJ_orMxVkDtgt3J" item="item_ff2792a3-d9b">no upfront government fees and higher loan limits</ref>; it also stated a specific <ref job="SRJ_YexVwL4jQzED" item="item_cabe1a09-afe">10-year HELOC draw and 20-year repayment structure</ref> without establishing that product's terms.
issues.suggestion: Replace categorical product-term templates with qualified examples, and defer lender-specific fees, insurance, limits and repayment terms to the licensed officer.
issues.label: Product accuracy

issues.description: For a Cleveland home search, the agent <ref job="SRJ_tnLpcVo9UDvp" item="item_ae043734-1c1">asserted the property was in Ohio</ref>, although the caller later specified <ref job="SRJ_tnLpcVo9UDvp" item="item_64c34e82-2b5">Cleveland, Tennessee</ref>; the same mistaken Ohio inference appears <ref job="SRJ_6VHHAGQQ8a7P" item="item_352aa2d2-028">in another conversation</ref>.
issues.suggestion: Do not infer a state from an ambiguous city name; ask for the state before discussing service-area coverage.
issues.label: Location accuracy
